verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents its own programmatic surfaces: a CLI that accesses server APIs, creates tokens and scaffolds and deploys agents, programmatic outbound calls, and token grants that include room create and delete. Nothing documents full parity with the UI, though. The browser-based Agent Builder and Cloud dashboard features (metrics views, rollback, phone-number provisioning) are not shown to have API equivalents, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage for Agent Builder and dashboard features, a published API spec, and independent corroboration.
